limitations: No automatic external ownership detection; explicit capture must be selected.
Default CORS silence remains ASR-CORS-01; explicit capture cannot bypass native restrictions.
Captured PCM ignores media mute/volume and does not include external graph effects or independent audio-track media.
No physical audio/Safari/device/recognition-service acceptance; ASR-05 and ASR-06 remain unfinished.
